note: Ye list tum khud edit kar sakte ho (GitHub me docs/macro.json). date = event ki date, end = alert kab tak (IST). level: caution = naya trade avoid ya qty aadhi, info = sirf dhyan. verify:true wali dates RBI/NSE site se ek baar confirm kar lena.

events.name: US Fed (FOMC) rate decision
events.note: Raat ~11:30 baje (India time) faisla aata hai. Agli subah India market me gap/hilna ho sakta hai.

events.name: US midterm election
events.note: US market me hilna ho sakta hai, India par asar aksar halka.

events.name: US jobs report (Non-farm payrolls)
events.note: Shaam ko aata hai; asar agle India trading din par.

events.name: India CPI (mehngai) data
events.note: Shaam ~4 baje aata hai; asar agle din.

events.name: RBI policy (MPC) decision
events.note: Subah ~10 baje faisla. 9:20 par entry ke baad turant hil sakta hai, khaaskar banks/NBFC/rate-sensitive.

events.name: Union Budget (India)
events.note: Poore market me bada hilna. Is din naya trade avoid.
